objective: Investigate and resolve why NorMuon/Anvil only match Adam; seek a substantial measured improvement through mechanism-driven PPO optimizer innovations.

benchmark_protocol.primary: Return averaged over trailing 200k environment steps at common 7.9M step.
secondary: Final 100 episode mean on succeeded >=7.9M runs.
Matched 1M, 2M, 4M, and 6M windows; reject last-window cherry picking.
Same-head Adam trunk control for natural-head attribution.
Same-floor zero-noise polar control for covariance filtering attribution.
benchmark_protocol.substantial_advantage_target: Seek roughly 10% or more over fresh Adam with consistent late-window improvement; this is an operational research target, not a statistical significance threshold or promise.
benchmark_protocol.uncertainty: One seed on one environment cannot establish robustness. Marginal differences do not resolve the user objective.

prior_evidence.interpretation: Marginal terminal-window difference does not demonstrate superiority; matching Adam is not task completion.

pending_hypotheses.prediction: Measured noise orientation improves heldout tangent alignment and fresh learning over the same-floor zero-noise polar control.
discriminators: Eight independent partitions of one fixed rollout; estimator sensitivity only.
Trace-matched isotropic filtering distinguishes orientation from attenuation.
Within-rollout covariance drift measured while restoring candidate gradients before updates.

discriminators: Exact epoch-clock parity with frozen v4, eager and compiled.
Warm actual Anvil versus switched warm slow rail, not cold comparison.

pending_hypotheses.prediction: Policy-metric head geometry allows the Anvil trunk to convert representation updates into larger useful policy gains.
discriminators: Current train KFAC quadratic versus sample Fisher quadratic isolates approximation.
Exact head-only KL versus local quadratic isolates finite-step error.
Pre-head versus post-head progression and direction reversals isolate residual oscillation.

first_noise_results.interpretation: Full filtering loses to Adam; lower noise weighting helps but still trails. Larger nominal step did not rescue it and was culled. Directional failure versus attenuation remains unresolved pending zero-noise control and held-out diagnostic.

first_fisher_results.interpretation: Anvil improves over same .001 headKL Adam trunk control but both lose to stock Adam. Smaller head radius improves Anvil yet still trails stock Adam. Need replay direction/curvature evidence before new iteration.

v9_iteration.hypothesis: Measured KFAC underprediction is mostly feature/Fisher dependence, since sample quadratic tracks exact finite KL. Retain KFAC direction but scale by current exact empirical head Fisher.

outcome.interpretation: Exact empirical sample-Fisher and finite head KL match target in1–4M. Calibration repaired; benchmark returns worse. Reject curvature miscalibration as sufficient cause or remedy; direction/trunk interaction still matter.

preparation.hypothesis: Retain stronger singular magnitudes to recover heldout alignment lost by full polarization; preserve successful fresh-rollout slow rail.

review.result: No blocking algebra/ownership issue. Diagnostic runtime mismatch repaired before execution: highest precision, TF32 disabled, matching trainer. Base-gradient cosines labeled explicitly.

failed_attempts.reason: Dynamo per-code eight-specialization cache limit across independent testpowers/shapes; compiler cache isolated between testcases/candidates, no trainer change.

v10_iteration.finding: Fractional weighting improves most firststep tangent matrix cosines but policy KL approximately4x at equal parameter norms; repeatedepochs oscillate. Directional efficiency often improves, but thirdchunk firststep decreases and finite held gains mixed. Uncalibrated fulltraining gate not met.
v10_iteration.next_hypothesis: Use original Anvil matrix proposal as counterfactual policy-space displacement budget, scaling fractional proposals by exact sample-Fisher geometry before retraction. Preserve rails and head/critic Adam; controlled nextversion required.

rollout_clock_results.interpretation: Meaningful mechanism improvement of3.9%/5.7% on primarywindow, below soughtlargeadvantage and onlyone seed.

v11_iteration.interpretation: Calibration fixes excessive policy displacement and improves mean first-step directional efficiency modestly; finite heldout clipped objective does not improve reliably. Fresh training is an uncertain falsification test, not a promised win.
v11_iteration.review: Fresh independent reviewer found no blocking algebra/ownership/state defect; highlighted finite gain and checkpoint scope limitations.
